india.one_line: Sarvam AI has launched its Prism decision model, while the I4C issued an advisory on AI-led cyberattacks.

themes.title: Sarvam launches Prism decision model
themes.text: Sarvam AI has released Prism, an open-weight decision model built on its Sarvam 105B foundation model for enterprise workflows.

stories.headline: Sarvam launches Prism open-weight decision model built on Sarvam 105B

themes.title: I4C issues AI-led cyberattack warning
themes.text: The Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre has warned banks and fintech firms that attackers are using AI agents to exploit software and payment APIs.

stories.headline: I4C warns Indian banks and fintechs of AI‑led cyberattacks
